assumptions: The GlobalWave contract ends on 2029-03-11 (confirmed by C. Alves, 2026-10-08). The contract still needs to be checked for a non-renewal notice deadline, auto-renew terms, data-return and exit-assistance terms.
A replacement must be live, staff trained, and GlobalWave data archived or converted before 2029-03-11.
Go-live is targeted for August 2028 (agreed at kickoff), which leaves about 7 months of buffer.
Small business lending is in scope (D01); the Numerated contract is expected to end around the same time as GlobalWave (not official yet).
Bank profile figures come from the Head of Commercial Lending and are treated as accurate. Vendor, pricing and regulatory points are working views until confirmed (see What we think).
